a: No-cost access to fabrication, characterization and staff for non-proprietary research
dt: CFN due Jan 31, May 31 and Sept 30. CNM next due Mar 5, 2027, 11:59 PM CT. Molecular Foundry and CINT run fall/spring calls; CNMS runs a spring call.
e: Peer-reviewed access to nanofabrication, microscopy, nanophotonics and quantum-materials tools at the five DOE nanocenters. Researchers from universities, labs and industry may apply, including students and postdocs, and foreign nationals are allowed with advance planning.
f: DOE Office of Science (BES) user facilities
n: DOE Nanoscale Science Research Centers user proposals (CFN, CNM, Molecular Foundry, CNMS, CINT)
unv: CNM dates confirmed on cnm.anl.gov Oct 26, 2026. CFN dates confirmed on bnl.gov Oct 12, 2026 (bnl.gov did not respond on Oct 26, 2026); nsrc.energy.gov lists no dates.
